entities.summary: The Essex class is a retired class of aircraft carriers of the United States Navy. The 20th century's most numerous class of capital ship, the class consisted of 24 vessels which came in "short-hull" and "long-hull" versions. Thirty-two ships were ordered, but as World War II wound down, six were canceled before construction and two were canceled after construction had begun. Fourteen saw combat during World War II. None were lost to enemy action although a few sustained crippling damage due to aerial attacks.
